features.name: Payload decode into typed, shaped array
features.description: Decode raw/gzip payload into real typed numeric values reshaped per sizes, not just a byte count.

features.name: Endianness byte-swapping
features.description: Byte-swap multi-byte typed data when host order differs from the declared endian field.

features.name: line skip / byte skip offset handling
features.description: Honor line skip/byte skip when computing the data offset (currently a correctness bug when ignored).

features.name: kinds (domain vs range axis semantics)
features.description: Distinguish spatial/domain axes from vector/tensor/color-channel range axes.

features.name: space / space directions / space origin
features.description: Map array indices to physical coordinates - essential for real scientific/medical use.

features.name: Key/value pair parsing (key:=value)
features.description: Correctly parse := lines instead of mis-splitting on the generic ':' partition.

features.name: raw and gzip encodings
features.description: Already implemented (byte-count only) in Phase 1/2; FACT-NRRD-101 makes this a real decode.
